translation: Gnó beag (§ 19 UStG) — ní thaispeánann admhálacha CBL, ach an nóta díolúine amháin

english: That time was just taken — here is what’s still free
translation: Tógadh an t-am sin díreach — seo an méid atá saor fós

english: These customers are already booked into this period. Hand each visit to a free colleague, or cancel it with a full refund.
translation: Tá na custaiméirí seo áirithe cheana sa tréimhse seo. Tabhair gach cuairt do chomhghleacaí saor, nó cealaigh í le haisíocaíocht iomlán.

english: Moved to {name} — the customer has been notified
translation: Bogtha go {name} — cuireadh an custaiméir ar an eolas

english: That colleague just got booked — list refreshed
translation: Tá an comhghleacaí sin áirithe díreach — liosta athnuaite

english: The shop is calling it off, so the customer pays nothing and gets everything back.
translation: Tá an siopa á cur ar ceal, mar sin ní íocann an custaiméir tada agus faigheann sé gach rud ar ais.

english: No messages with this customer yet. Say hello — a short note before an appointment is the cheapest way to stop a no-show.
translation: Gan aon teachtaireacht leis an gcustaiméir seo go fóill. Abair haigh — is é nóta gearr roimh choinne an bealach is saoire chun cosc a chur ar dhuine gan teacht.
Athraigh go dtí an dearadh nua
Ar ais chuig an dearadh clasaiceach

english: Replies are public on your shop page. Future customers read how you handle a bad day at least as closely as they read the rating.
translation: Tá freagraí poiblí ar leathanach do shiopa. Léann custaiméirí amach anseo conas a láimhseálann tú droch-lá chomh géar le mar a léann siad an rátáil.
Cuir teachtaireacht chuig an gcustaiméir seo

english: That time has just been taken
An offer shows on the customer’s bookings page for 30 minutes with that exact time. It doesn’t hold the seat — first come stays first served.
translation: Taispeántar tairiscint ar leathanach áirithintí an chustaiméara ar feadh 30 nóiméad leis an am beacht sin. Ní choinníonn sí an suíochán — fanann an chéad duine isteach ar dtús.

english: People who asked to be told when a day frees up. When a cancellation opens a slot, they are the first call to make.
translation: Daoine a d’iarr go n-inseofaí dóibh nuair a shaorfar lá. Nuair a osclaíonn cealú sliotán, is iadsan an chéad ghlaoch le déanamh.

english: Click a day to book time off for that person; click an existing absence to remove it. Bars show how full a working day already is.
translation: Cliceáil lá chun am saor a áirithint don duine sin; cliceáil neamhláithreacht atá ann cheana chun í a bhaint. Taispeánann barraí cé chomh lán is atá lá oibre cheana.
Gan a bheith ar an rota

english: An absence removes that person’s hours from the calendar, so no customer can book them while away.
translation: Baineann neamhláithreacht uaireanta an duine sin den fhéilire, mar sin ní féidir le custaiméir iad a áirithint agus iad ar shiúl.

english: Anything the shop should know? (allergies, wishes…)
translation: Aon rud ba cheart don siopa a fhios? (ailléirgí, mianta…)

english: No customers yet — they appear here as soon as someone books.
translation: Gan aon chustaiméir go fóill — feictear anseo iad a luaithe a dhéanann duine áirithint.

english: People are matched by phone number when they gave one, so the same customer stays one record across their phone, their laptop and the front desk. Private notes are yours alone — customers never see them.
translation: Meaitseáiltear daoine de réir uimhir ghutháin nuair a thug siad ceann, ionas go bhfanann an custaiméir céanna ina thaifead amháin ar a nguthán, a ríomhaire glúine agus ag an deasc tosaigh. Is leatsa amháin nótaí príobháideacha — ní fheiceann custaiméirí iad riamh.

english: Shuts the whole shop — public holidays, renovation, the summer break. Nobody can be booked on these days, without touching anyone’s roster.
translation: Dúnann an siopa ar fad — saoire phoiblí, athchóiriú, an sos samhraidh. Ní féidir aon duine a áirithint ar na laethanta seo, gan tada a dhéanamh do rota aon duine.

english: The rest is cut into start times on the shop’s slot grid, and each candidate must fit the whole service plus the before/after buffers.
translation: Gearrtar an chuid eile ina amanna tosaigh ar ghreille sliotán an tsiopa, agus caithfidh gach iarrthóir an tseirbhís iomlán móide na maoláin roimh/tar éis a fheistiú.

english: At checkout the seat is held for 8 minutes and the database has the last word — a seat can only ever belong to one booking.
translation: Ag an tseiceáil amach coinnítear an suíochán ar feadh 8 nóiméad agus tá an focal deiridh ag an mbunachar sonraí — ní fhéadfaidh suíochán a bheith ag níos mó ná áirithint amháin.

english: {name} still has upcoming appointments — reassign or cancel them below first.
translation: Tá coinní le teacht ag {name} fós — athshann nó cealaigh iad thíos ar dtús.

english: Demo environment — bookings are simulated, no real payments.
translation: Timpeallacht taispeána — áirithintí insamhlaithe, gan íocaíochtaí fíora.

english: I accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy (required)
translation: Glacaim leis na Téarmaí Seirbhíse agus an Polasaí Príobháideachais (riachtanach)

english: Demo session — real OAuth activates once the provider is enabled in Supabase.
translation: Seisiún taispeána — gníomhachtaítear OAuth fíor nuair a chumasaítear an soláthraí i Supabase.

english: Almost there — confirm the link we just emailed you, then sign in.
translation: Beagnach ann — deimhnigh an nasc a sheol muid chugat le r-phost, ansin sínigh isteach.

english: Everything stored about you — GDPR Art. 20.
translation: Gach rud atá stóráilte fút — GDPR Airt. 20.

english: Really delete your account and profile? Bookings history in shops stays for legal retention.
translation: An bhfuil tú cinnte gur mhaith leat do chuntas agus do phróifíl a scriosadh? Fanann stair áirithintí sna siopaí le haghaidh coinneála dlíthiúla.

english: This signs you out everywhere and removes your profile. It cannot be undone.
translation: Sínítear amach thú i ngach áit agus baintear do phróifíl. Ní féidir é a chealú.

english: 🗑 Your profile, preferences and favourites are deleted.
translation: 🗑 Scriostar do phróifíl, do roghanna agus do cheanna is fearr.

english: 🔒 Past receipts stay with the salons — German law requires them to keep invoices for the statutory retention period.
translation: 🔒 Fanann admhálacha caite leis na salóin — éilíonn dlí na Gearmáine orthu sonraisc a choinneáil ar feadh na tréimhse coinneála reachtúla.

english: 📅 Upcoming appointments are NOT cancelled. Cancel them first if you do not want to go.
translation: 📅 Ní chealaítear coinní le teacht. Cealaigh iad ar dtús mura bhfuil tú ag iarraidh dul.

english: 📦 Download your data first — after this it is gone.
translation: 📦 Íoslódáil do shonraí ar dtús — tar éis seo tá siad imithe.

english: Account deleted. Sorry to see you go.
translation: Cuntas scriosta. Brón orainn thú a fheiceáil ag imeacht.

english: 📅 Existing appointments stay booked — customers still expect you.
translation: 📅 Fanann coinní atá ann cheana áirithe — tá custaiméirí ag súil leat fós.

english: 🚫 You lose access immediately, on every device signed in to this account.
translation: 🚫 Caillfidh tú rochtain láithreach, ar gach gléas atá sínithe isteach leis an gcuntas seo.

english: 📅 Appointments already booked with them are NOT cancelled — move them first.
translation: 📅 Ní chealaítear coinní atá áirithe leo cheana — bog iad ar dtús.

english: The slot is freed and the customer is notified.
translation: Saorfar an sliotán agus cuirfear an custaiméir ar an eolas.

english: ⚠️ Cancelling on the customer’s behalf skips the cancellation fee.
translation: ⚠️ Má chealaítear ar son an chustaiméara, scipeáiltear an táille cealaithe.

english: Free to join · 12 % commission only on completed online bookings · payouts weekly via Stripe
translation: Saor in aisce le bheith páirteach · coimisiún 12 % ar áirithintí ar líne críochnaithe amháin · íocaíochtaí seachtainiúla trí Stripe
